text: As you sense a mysterious presence and enter Noeliel Castle,\na figure who calls himself Dutannen appears.\nJoin forces with Agios to defeat him!
You return to the entrance of the castle to evacuate Velly\nwho loses her power. You see a flight of stairs to the\nbasement with many monsters. Get rid of them to proceed!
As you descend, you can see a monster lying in wait for you.\nIt kinda looks different from the other monsters...\nDefeat it anyway and proceed!
After obtaining Dull Crest, Ice Orbs appear on\nthe pedestals. There seems to be some kind of massive trick\nbehind this. Solve the mystery with Agios!
Join forces with Agios to defeat Dutannen who plans to turn\nNoeliel Castle into an anti-Xmas base and retrieve\nthe castle!
[[MR]]The trick in Noeliel Castle is solved and the anti-Xmas\nenergy is weakened.
